# Production-Grade CDC & Cache Invalidation Pipeline Architecture ## Architecture Overview ```mermaid graph TB subgraph "PostgreSQL Shards" PG1[PostgreSQL Shard 1
Tenants A-F] PG2[PostgreSQL Shard 2
Tenants G-L] PG3[PostgreSQL Shard 3
Tenants M-R] PG4[PostgreSQL Shard 4
Tenants S-Z] end subgraph "CDC Layer" CDC1[Debezium Connector 1] CDC2[Debezium Connector 2] CDC3[Debezium Connector 3] CDC4[Debezium Connector 4] subgraph "Kafka Cluster" KAFKA1[Kafka Broker 1] KAFKA2[Kafka Broker 2] KAFKA3[Kafka Broker 3] end end subgraph "Processing Layer" FLINK[Kafka Streams/Flink
Event Processor] BACKPRESSURE[Backpressure
Controller] end subgraph "Cache Layer" REDIS[Redis Cluster
Cache-Aside] OPENSEARCH[OpenSearch
Full-Text Search] end subgraph "Monitoring & Control" METRICS[Prometheus/Grafana] ALERTS[Alert Manager] DLQ[Dead Letter Queue] end PG1 --> CDC1 PG2 --> CDC2 PG3 --> CDC3 PG4 --> CDC4 CDC1 --> KAFKA1 CDC2 --> KAFKA2 CDC3 --> KAFKA3 CDC4 --> KAFKA1 KAFKA1 <--> KAFKA2 KAFKA2 <--> KAFKA3 KAFKA3 <--> KAFKA1 KAFKA1 --> FLINK KAFKA2 --> FLINK KAFKA3 --> FLINK FLINK --> BACKPRESSURE BACKPRESSURE --> REDIS BACKPRESSURE --> OPENSEARCH FLINK --> DLQ FLINK --> METRICS METRICS --> ALERTS ``` ## Component Breakdown ### 1. PostgreSQL Layer (4 Shards) - **Sharding Strategy**: Tenant-based hash sharding - **WAL Configuration**: - `wal_level = logical` - `max_replication_slots = 10` - `max_wal_senders = 10` - `track_commit_timestamp = on` ### 2. CDC Layer (Debezium Connectors) - **Connector Configuration**: - Logical replication slots per shard - Heartbeat messages every 100ms - Transaction metadata inclusion - Schema change capture enabled ### 3. Message Broker (Kafka/Redpanda) - **Topic Design**: - `postgres.cdc.shard1`, `postgres.cdc.shard2`, etc. - Replication factor: 3 - Partitions: 12 per topic (for parallelism) - Retention: 7 days ### 4. Stream Processing (Kafka Streams/Flink) - **Processing Logic**: - Event ordering and deduplication - Version conflict resolution - Cache invalidation coordination ### 5. Cache Layer - **Redis Cluster**: 6-node cluster (3 masters, 3 replicas) - **OpenSearch**: 9-node cluster (3 masters, 6 data nodes) ## Event Schema Design ### Base CDC Event Structure ```json { "event_id": "uuid-v4", "source": { "shard_id": "shard-1", "schema": "public", "table": "users", "txId": 123456789, "commit_time": "2024-01-15T10:30:45.123Z", "lsn": "0/12345678" }, "operation": "INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE", "before": { /* previous state */ }, "after": { /* new state */ }, "sequence_number": 1234567890, "version": 1, "tenant_id": "tenant-a", "partition_key": "tenant-a:users:12345", "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:45.123Z" } ``` ### Cache Invalidation Event ```json { "invalidation_id": "uuid-v4", "cache_key": "tenant-a:user:12345", "operation": "INVALIDATE|UPDATE|DELETE", "version": 1, "sequence_number": 1234567890, "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:45.123Z", "source_event_id": "original-event-uuid", "ttl": 300000 } ``` ## Cache Invalidation Strategy ### Versioned Lease Approach #### 1. Redis Cache-Aside Pattern ```python class CacheManager: def get_with_version(self, key): # Get cached value with version cached = redis.hgetall(f"{key}:meta") if not cached: return None, 0 version = int(cached.get('version', 0)) data = redis.get(f"{key}:data") return data, version def set_with_version(self, key, value, version): pipe = redis.pipeline() pipe.hset(f"{key}:meta", mapping={'version': version}) pipe.setex(f"{key}:data", 300, value) # 5-minute TTL pipe.execute() def invalidate_if_stale(self, key, current_version): cached_version = self.get_version(key) if cached_version < current_version: redis.delete(f"{key}:meta", f"{key}:data") ``` #### 2. Conflict Resolution Logic ```java public class EventProcessor { public void processEvent(CDCEvent event) { String cacheKey = generateCacheKey(event); long eventVersion = event.getVersion(); long eventSequence = event.getSequenceNumber(); // Check if we have a newer version already processed long storedVersion = getStoredVersion(cacheKey); long storedSequence = getStoredSequence(cacheKey); if (storedVersion > eventVersion || (storedVersion == eventVersion && storedSequence > eventSequence)) { // Stale event, skip processing metrics.incrementStaleEvents(); return; } // Process the event applyToCache(event, cacheKey); updateMetadata(cacheKey, eventVersion, eventSequence); } } ``` ##
